selection: Retain existing successes; show the first accepted additional checkpoint attempt for each previously failed case. Preserve all attempts.
scope: Decision records for the 30-case overview. All current trial outcomes, supplied text states, candidate definitions, original probabilities and resulting states are included. Original observation images, full physics trajectories and historical task-version trials remain in the local recording library and are not bundled here. The 21 illustrative 3D replays are not the model input images; added display geometry was not used for collision checks. Nine cases use original interface recordings. These controlled examples are separate from the benchmark evaluations.

obstacle_push.title: Push a part around the fixture
obstacle_push.description: Choose a contact path around the barrier from seven persistent motion controls. Contact with the obstacle remains a failure even if the part later reaches the target.

frontend.title: Repair the checkout at three widths
frontend.description: Repair card width, shrinking child elements and touch-target size separately. Chromium measures visibility, overflow and 44 px targets at 320, 390 and 680 px; stale measurements cannot authorize publication.

drone.title: Deliver with an energy reserve
drone.description: Plan for route energy, pad occupancy, waiting and landing, then deliver with at least 12 energy units in reserve. Waiting consumes energy; releasing before landing loses the payload.

satellite.title: Register and classify the change
satellite.description: Register the offset images, mask clouds and measure vegetation change before classification. Export the correct region and coordinate reference as actual GeoJSON.

sql.title: Repair the revenue dashboard
sql.description: Repair aggregation on actual SQLite data containing equal order amounts, NULLs, drafts and one-to-many lines. Both EXISTS and pre-aggregation can work; SUM(DISTINCT) loses legitimate equal-value orders.

lab.title: Prepare a calibrated mixture
lab.description: Calibrate the pipette, transfer 40 µL blue and 20 µL red into B3, and mix without contaminating the stocks. Calibration after a transfer does not repair a wrong dose; excessive mixing speed spills liquid.

lane_change.title: Drive around the roadworks
lane_change.description: Choose among eight persistent controls using measured geometry. Drive around the roadworks, return and stop without obstacle contact.

procurement.title: Build a compliant camera quote
procurement.description: Compare hardware, commercial licensing, stock, shipping cost and a three-day deadline against a 650 total budget. Changing the product invalidates the prior quote assumptions.

quality.title: Distinguish a defect from a blemish
quality.description: Distinguish cosmetic surface marks from electrical discontinuity before diverting a board. Optical inspection and measured resistance must lead to the correct shipment, without discarding intact boards.

security.title: Contain abuse without blocking users
security.description: An abusive source IP also carries five legitimate sessions. Compare session policies and replay traffic before deployment, preserving both browser and non-browser legitimate clients.

calendar.title: Coordinate a conflict-free meeting
calendar.description: Convert attendee time zones and include 15-minute buffers. Coordinate room occupancy, capacity and a portable display kit, refreshing availability after each draft change.

assembly.title: Commission the inspection rover
assembly.description: Commission an inspection rover with a 24 V bus, a 5 V camera rail, inspection firmware, fresh wiring measurements and camera calibration. Mechanical access, power isolation and test validity constrain the order of work.

spreadsheet.title: Reconcile the order revisions
spreadsheet.description: Keep the latest order revision, parse each row using its own locale and reconcile missing quantities with a shipping ledger. Validate the revenue and export the real cleaned CSV.

ci.title: Repair and execute the release bundle
ci.description: Package the entry point, settings and selected locale assets, then execute the bundle smoke test. A configuration change after testing requires a fresh build and test before staging.

warehouse_rover.title: Navigate through the shelf aisles
warehouse_rover.description: Choose among eight waypoints from the current pose and shelf geometry. The Husky must reach its dock without contact; candidate names do not reveal the safe sequence.

conveyor_sorting.title: Sort the parcel
conveyor_sorting.description: Advance and stop the belt, grasp the green parcel, and place it in the matching bin. All nine recorded choices are retained.

research.title: Resolve conflicting documentation
research.description: Resolve conflicting documentation versions, cite both the current reference and release notes, and run the local command-argument checker before saving the evidence.

fleet.title: Dispatch within vehicle limits
fleet.description: Coordinate payload, cold-chain temperature, range budget and bridge clearance. Repeated dispatches consume resources, so a correct vehicle assignment alone does not complete both deliveries.

drawer_opening.title: Open the drawer
drawer_opening.description: Reach and grasp the handle, pull the drawer open by 14.86 cm, then release it. The close view exposes the sliding mechanism.

performance.title: Reduce queries within a memory limit
performance.description: Preserve the fresh, complete SQLite result with at most six queries and 24 rows per fetch. A single large batch violates the memory bound; stale caches and limited results fail correctness. Chunking and streaming are both supported.

peg_insertion.title: Insert the peg
peg_insertion.description: Grasp the green peg, lift it over the cyan socket, lower it and release it to settle inside the opening.

inbox.title: Triage the complete threads
inbox.description: Read the latest reply and verify the sender before filing. An urgent subject may already be resolved; a receipt subject may conceal a failed payment and deadline.

crosswalk.title: Yield while the pedestrian moves
crosswalk.description: The pedestrian moves independently as simulated time advances. Choose where to wait and for how long; entering while occupied remains a violation after the pedestrian clears.

service.title: Recover at full request load
service.description: One current replica lacks full-load capacity; another has stale data. Prepare a replica, test a canary, promote traffic, probe the full load and drain the failed primary without losing the rollout error budget.

warehouse.title: Pick and deliver the parcel
warehouse.description: Navigate to the rack, load the matching SKU, scan its barcode and secure the fragile parcel before padded dispatch. Wrong cargo and transit damage persist into the receipt.

block_stacking.title: Stack the blocks
block_stacking.description: Grasp and lift the green block, seat it on the blue base, and release the stack. The side view makes the contact height visible.

control_panel.title: Commission the interlocked fixture
control_panel.description: Use short and long physical button presses to isolate power, bleed pressure, clamp and commission a fixture at 20–30 kPa. Loaded clamping and overpressure create faults. Button travel is Bullet physics; pressure and interlocks use an explicit state model.

reverse_parking.title: Reverse into the empty bay
reverse_parking.description: Choose incremental reverse or forward motions using measured bay and vehicle bounds. The entire vehicle must fit between the parked cars, rather than only its reference point.

chess.title: Find a forced mate in two
chess.description: Find a forced mate in two in a nine-piece position. All legal moves are available without checkmate labels; a defending search chooses a legal reply that avoids mate when possible.

driving.title: Yield, merge and stop safely
driving.description: Treat crosswalk clearance and the rear-lane gap as separate observations. Use a current gap measurement to merge safely, reach the north exit and stop.

observation.query:
SELECT o.region, SUM(o.total) AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND i.returned = 0
GROUP BY o.region

observed_physics.feedback: Ready.

state.environment: 3D physics simulation; actions command physical motors.

decisions.instructions: Choose the next available motion primitive that advances the goal. Use the camera and measured physical state. A grasp requires closing both fingers around the object; use contact feedback before transporting it. Do not finish before the goal is physically completed. Power=false means the fixture is already isolated; another short blue press energizes it again. Read the measured pressure and the distinct short/long operations. Do not keep toggling power when pressure must change. Clamping requires power isolated and pressure at most 5 kPa. The pump requires the clamp closed and power energized. Accept only when powered, clamped and pressure is in range.

options.description: Finish. Stop without any further movement.
Blue · long press. Requires powered=false. Physically hold blue to reduce pressure to 0 kPa and reset a fault. Holding while powered causes a fault.
Blue · short press. Toggle power: powered=true becomes false (isolated); powered=false becomes true (energized). Does not bleed pressure.
Amber · long press. Open the fixture clamp; pressure above 5 kPa loads the seal.
Green · short press. Measure the powered, clamped fixture and accept pressure in the 20–30 kPa range.
Green · long press. Run the pump for one 28 kPa charge interval; requires power and a closed clamp.
Amber · short press. Close the fixture clamp; it requires isolated power and pressure at most 5 kPa.

options.description: Amber · short press. Close the fixture clamp; it requires isolated power and pressure at most 5 kPa.

Stop without acceptance. End the run without any further movement. Does not measure, accept or commission the fixture.
Blue · short press. Toggle power: powered=true becomes false (isolated); powered=false becomes true (energized). Does not bleed pressure.
